How It Works

From plan to movement in under a minute.

1. Plan

The planner finds a time that fits your day.

Your workout is planned around your schedule, so you know exactly when it's time to move.

2. Prepare

Everything is ready when it's time.

No complicated routines or decisions. Just pick up your deck and get started.

3. Draw

Draw your cards.

Let the deck decide what comes next. No planning, no scrolling, no overthinking.

4. Scan

Scan the QR code.

Get instant access to the exercise instructions and see exactly how to perform the movement.

5. Move

Just start.

Your plan is made. Your cards are drawn. Now you move.
